title: Non-negative Matrix Factorisation with Topological Regularisation
abstract: arXiv:2606.17531v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Non-negative matrix factorisation (NMF) learns additive representations from data, but non-negativity alone does not ensure interpretable basis functions. We introduce Top-NMF, which guides basis learning through general topological preferences without prescribing the detailed form of the components. Observations and basis vectors are treated as non-negative functions on structured domains. Discrete topological conditions are difficult to optimise directly. Our guiding viewpoint is that persistent homology provides a stable, continuous relaxation of ordinary homological invariants: it tracks connected components and loops across thresholds, allowing structural preferences to be expressed through continuous scores suitable for optimisation. translated_title: 带拓扑正则化的非负矩阵分解
translated_abstract: 非负矩阵分解（NMF）从数据中学习加性表示，但仅凭非负性约束并不能保证基函数的可解释性。我们提出了Top-NMF，该方法通过一般性的拓扑偏好来引导基学习，而无需规定分量的具体形式。观测数据和基向量被视为结构化域上的非负函数。离散的拓扑条件难以直接优化，我们的核心观点是：持续同调为普通同调不变量提供了稳定且连续的松弛形式——它能够在不同阈值上追踪连通分量和环路，从而使结构偏好可以表达为适合优化的连续评分。我们为连通的图像区域、类团（clique-like）图结构以及周期性时间序列分量构造了此类拓扑评分，并将其纳入统一的NMF目标函数中。对于图数据，我们推导了（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了Top-NMF方法，利用持续同调提供的连续拓扑评分作为正则化项，引导非负矩阵分解学习满足期望拓扑结构（如图像连通性、类团图结构和时间序列周期性）且更可解释的基向量。
en_tdlr: Top-NMF introduces topological regularisation for non-negative matrix factorisation by using continuous topological scores derived from persistent homology, guiding basis learning towards desired structural properties (connectivity in images, clique-like graph structures, and periodicity in time series) for more interpretable representations.
